summary: Mission 1 Day Care Backend Foundation: comprehensive pytest suite (16 tests) covering all 15 acceptance criteria from the review request — all 16/16 PASS. Covers /api/admin/pricing GET/PUT (with hourly_*↔daycare_* isolation), /api/slots/available branching for hourly|daycare|birthday (incl. 'no auto-seed for daycare'), /api/bookings/hourly + /hourly/offline + /hourly/guest-offline classification (PK-D-* / PK-H-* prefix + DB-level service_type stamping), birthday-slot rejection on the hourly endpoint, capacity enforcement on daycare slots, /api/payments/create-checkout type=hourly returning the expected 'manual' payload (PAYMENT_PROVIDER=manual), and birthday/subscription regression. Dev-only seed script (scripts/seed_daycare_slots.js) was exercised both --dry-run and live, and shown to be idempotent (re-run reports 0 created / 9 already existed).

verification_matrix.2_pricing_put_daycare_isolation: PASS (PUT only daycare_* leaves hourly_* untouched, and vice-versa)
verification_matrix.3_seed_script_dry_run_and_live_idempoten: PASS (dry-run reports without persisting; live run on existing dates reports 0 created / 9 already existed)
verification_matrix.4_slots_available_daycare_seeded_only: PASS (returns only seeded daycare slots; far-future date with no seed returns empty array — NEVER auto-creates)
verification_matrix.7_hourly_endpoint_books_daycare_PKD_serv: PASS (booking_code starts PK-D-, amount==daycare_<duration>hr, DB-persisted service_type='daycare')
verification_matrix.8_hourly_endpoint_books_main_area_PKH_se: PASS (booking_code starts PK-H-, amount==hourly_<duration>hr, DB-persisted service_type='main_area')
verification_matrix.10_hourly_guest_offline_daycare: PASS (no auth, payment_method=cash, PK-D- prefix + DB service_type='daycare')
verification_matrix.13_capacity_enforcement_no_increment_on_: PASS (11 children on capacity-10 daycare slot rejected; booked_count unchanged)
verification_matrix.15_subscription_plans_regression: PASS (GET /api/subscriptions/plans returns 200 with plans field; list is empty in dev DB which is acceptable)

minor.issue: Successful response payload does NOT echo the new service_type field on the booking object — only booking_code (PK-D-*/PK-H-*) is returned. The field IS persisted correctly in MongoDB (verified by direct query). Frontend consumers that want service_type without re-fetching will need it added to the response shape. Non-blocking for Mission 1 since the prefix is the canonical signal.

Hourly keys are exposed as hourly_1hr / hourly_2hr / hourly_3hr / hourly_extra_hr (NOT a literal hourly_4hr). The review-request phrase 'four hourly_* keys' is satisfied numerically (4 keys) but naming is asymmetric vs daycare_1hr/2hr/3hr/4hr. Cosmetic, no behavior impact since /api/bookings/hourly correctly prices 4-hour main_area bookings via getServicePrice helpers.
Returns {plans: []} in this dev pod — no plan documents seeded. Endpoint itself works (200). Out of Mission 1 scope but worth noting if a downstream test relies on a populated plans list.

action_items: (Optional / minor) Echo service_type on the response body of /api/bookings/hourly + /offline + /guest-offline so clients don't have to infer it from the booking_code prefix.
(Cosmetic) Consider exposing pricing as hourly_4hr in /api/admin/pricing for symmetry with daycare_4hr — or document that 4-hour main_area pricing is computed as hourly_3hr + hourly_extra_hr.
critical_code_review_comments: Mission 1 contract is met: routes/bookings.js getServiceClassification() correctly stamps service_type and selects PK-D / PK-H from slot.slot_type for ALL three endpoints (regular, offline, guest-offline). Verified via direct MongoDB read of the persisted HourlyBooking documents.

scripts/seed_daycare_slots.js is correctly idempotent (uniqueness on date+start_time prevents duplicates), supports --dry-run, --start, --end, --capacity, and is intentionally NOT wired into any router — confirmed via grep.
Capacity enforcement on daycare slots uses slot.capacity (not the legacy hardcoded 70 for main area). Overbook attempt left booked_count unchanged.
GET /api/slots/available?slot_type=daycare correctly skips auto-generation — far-future un-seeded dates return [] instead of fabricated slots. Hourly auto-generation regression intact (79 slots).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite location: /app/backend/tests/test_daycare_mission1.py. Re-run: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_daycare_mission1.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/daycare_mission1.xml`. The suite auto-seeds daycare slots through the dev script in a session-scoped fixture; no prior setup needed. Pricing values DO drift across runs because the isolation-PUT tests bump daycare_1..4hr to 11/19/26/33 — the booking-amount assertions read live pricing dynamically, so this is safe. PAYMENT_PROVIDER=manual is the dev posture; do NOT change that. Pricing currently in DB after this run: daycare_1hr=11, daycare_2hr=19, daycare_3hr=26, daycare_4hr=33 (vs documented defaults 8/15/22/28). If a future test cares about exact defaults, reset via PUT before asserting.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defects found. Initial test failures were all test-script issues (response shape mismatch — endpoint returns {bookings:[...]}, pricing wrapped in {pricing:{...}}, hourly key named hourly_extra_hr not hourly_4hr, guest-offline requires payment_method); fixed in the suite. Functionality confirmed correct end-to-end including DB-level service_type persistence.
